t: This is the Mercantile Marine Memorial, in the EC3N area of Tower Hamlets. It was designed by Edwin Lutyens, an architect known for imaginatively adapting traditional styles and for designing many war memorials. The sculpture is by William Reid Dick, a Scottish sculptor known for his stylised monument sculptures and the simplicity of his portraits. He became a Royal Academician in 1928, and was knighted in 1935. Two of the best-known names in British memorial design worked together here.
